description: Users report being unable to log in or access their accounts, sometimes after repeated attempts.
Users describe premium prompts, difficulty signing up for Premium, and limited access to music without a subscription.
Users report missing songs or lyrics, repetitive playback choices, and recommendations that have worsened.
Users report trouble downloading music, listening offline, and keeping downloaded files available.
Users express broad dissatisfaction with the app or say a recent update needs rework.
Users report playback that stops, fails to start, shows a blank screen, or plays unexpected content.
Users report changed or missing controls, difficulty navigating playlists or finding features, and frequent ads.
